title: Retry deployment and resolve deployment error

requirements.text: Investigate the reported deployment failure and implement the minimal code/config changes needed so the project builds and deploys successfully to the Internet Computer using the documented commands (dfx generate backend, pnpm build:skip-bindings, dfx deploy).

quotes: 🙏 लॉन्च सफल नहीं हुआ: Deployment error

acceptanceCriteria: Running `dfx generate backend` completes without errors.
Running `dfx deploy` completes without errors and publishes updated frontend + backend canisters.
The deployed site loads successfully in a browser with no blank screen caused by runtime errors.

requirements.text: Add/adjust developer-facing deployment troubleshooting notes in `frontend/PUBLISHING.md` to reflect the actual current build/deploy prerequisites and the most likely failure points encountered in this project (e.g., missing static assets referenced by the UI, unused imports causing build failure, mismatched generated bindings). Use English text only.

quotes: 🙏 लॉन्च सफल नहीं हुआ: Deployment error

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/PUBLISHING.md` includes a concise troubleshooting section with at least: (1) how to identify missing static assets, (2) what to do if `dfx generate backend` outputs outdated bindings, and (3) what to check when `dfx deploy` fails.
All added documentation text is in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding new product features or new sections to the website.
Changing authentication approach (Internet Identity remains as-is).
Introducing external databases, third-party hosting, or non-IC deployment targets.
